decision.rationale: TXN-007862 is a 21.44 EUR (2144 minor units) charge from Larkspur Media (MER-000017) on card CRD-000133. The merchant bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-09-18 and posted on 2026-09-19. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 38 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone and has nothing in writing. No documents are attached to the dispute, so there is no cancellation confirmation from the merchant. Without one, there is no effective cancellation date to compare with the charge date, and we cannot tell which came first. Under recurring-no-proof, we have to ask the merchant for its cancellation records and the subscription terms.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide your cancellation records for this card's Larkspur Media subscription, including any cancellation request by phone and the date it took effect, and the subscription terms that applied to the 21.44 EUR charge made on 2026-09-18.
